_comment: Curated catalog of skills + agents recommended for USER's typical work: graphics programming, Unreal Engine 5, AI/ML, MCP development. Each item points at a public GitHub source — the Library -> Catalog tab installs via library_install_from_github. Add/edit freely; the GUI re-reads this file on every Catalog mount.

items.name: graphics-programmer
